# 1000 Delegation
A function of the director-general under a provision of this Act mentioned in an item in table 1000, column 2, is for the period mentioned in column 3 for the item (the delegation period) taken to have been delegated to a person who during the delegation period occupied a position with a position number mentioned in column 4 for the item.
